description: A .NET client library (written in VB.NET) for the Open Journal Systems (OJS) 3.5 REST API: submissions, publications, issues, users, contexts, DOIs, statistics and more.
Building blocks for Entity Framework Core: base entities, automatic auditing and soft delete through interceptors, optimistic concurrency, paging and model conventions.
Jyuno SDK: 대화형 Jyuno 프롬프트, 스크립트 실행/검사, Native JS(JavaScript) 변환, 그리고 Jyuno 언어 서버(LSP)를 제공하는 jyuno 명령어입니다.
